remarks: Be the first to enjoy this thoughtfully renovated 4-bedroom home in the heart of historic Glenville which has been completely remodeled and expanded in 2025 with a low maintenance lifestyle in mind. The home is flooded with natural light and features an open floor plan with the option of a first-floor primary bedroom. The kitchen and dining area includes a large island, stainless steel appliances and clean, modern finishes. The second floor offers three spacious bedrooms and a large full bath with a separate sink/shower room. The finished lower level has two versatile rooms-ideal for a home office, gym, or playroom plus a third full bath. A classic front porch provides the perfect spot to sit and take in the neighborhood, while the backyard features stone walls and a generous patio made entertaining. The large two car garage offers plenty of storage and comes ready to charge your EV!
